proposalNote: Every commission is priced individually. Your written proposal sets out the investment in full, before any deposit.
shippingNote: Shipping is included and fully insured to the UK, Europe and the United States for most commissions. Exceptionally large or heavy pieces may carry an additional freight charge, passed on at cost and stated in your proposal, before you commit. For delivery elsewhere, contact us to confirm delivery to your country.
customsNote: Following the UK-India trade deal that took effect in July 2026, UK deliveries no longer carry customs charges or import duty. For deliveries outside the UK, import duty and local VAT are payable by the recipient on arrival.
